amy.sales: Hey team — enterprise asks for a 10-day Dedicated POC (Azure). Must present a single IPv4 for their perimeter (one /32) and wants separate tokens for dev/poc. Need lead time and a concise SOW blurb.
raj.eng: We can create per-environment tokens scoped to the Dedicated project and set expirations. No issue.
lucy.net: For a guaranteed single /32 we reserve a static Public IP and attach it to our NAT gateway. Important: to guarantee no IP changes we must constrain egress to a single gateway and avoid cross-AZ failover for the POC window.
amy.sales: If they insist on HA but still one IP, any option?
lucy.net: Complex — we could do active/passive with a floating IP but that needs extra infra and approvals. For short POC the easiest is single AZ + pinned NAT. Call that tradeoff out in the SOW.
sam.solutions: SOW snippet you can copy: "Provision temporary Dedicated cluster (N GPUs) constrained to a single egress gateway to guarantee a static outbound IP (one /32); allocate reserved public IPv4; generate time-limited API tokens scoped per environment; run connectivity smoke tests; provide monitoring access. Customer to add provided IP and hostname to perimeter allowlist."
amy.sales: Any sample allowlist lines and quick smoke-test I can send?
lucy.net: Recommend both IP and hostname in case their firewall checks SNI:
ALLOW TCP/443 to 203.0.113.77/32
ALLOW HOST: dedicated.az.redwood.example.com
Curl test:
```
curl -v --resolve "dedicated.az.redwood.example.com:443:203.0.113.77" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer <POC_TOKEN>" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  https://dedicated.az.redwood.example.com/v1/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-3b","input":"ping"}'
```
raj.eng: Lead time if SOW signed today: reserve IP (same day if in pool, otherwise 1 business day), create cluster + attach NAT (1 business day), keys + smoke tests (same day) — estimate 48-72 hours. Private peering (no public IP) is longer (4-10 days) due to network approvals.
provision-bot: Created ticket INF-9001 to reserve 203.0.113.77 and schedule Dedicated cluster creation. Assigned lucy.net. ETA 72h. :white_check_mark:
amy.sales: Perfect — I'll send the two options (A: static /32 + timeboxed tokens, fast; B: private peering/no public IP, slower) and request the signed SOW. Will update when they choose.
